evidence.explanation: JS random.rn2 defaults to the production rn2 helper; this C-only call edge is an interface alias.
evidence.proof: Exact C flip_level_rnd dispatch body and public JS generation-mode flip_level_rnd agree across all nine flp 0..3/draw-bit combinations plus two default JS RNG seeds. C captures outgoing mask and draw count; JS exposes selected axes using one corridor marker on an otherwise empty full-floor map. No full C flip execution or independent RNG equivalence claim.
evidence.control: All-zero choices across masks 0,1,2,3 leave the marker fixed; disabled axes consume no draws. Enabled axes each draw rn2(2) in vertical-then-horizontal order.
